H5600.def: from «05603»; a (sea-going) vessel (as ceiled with a deck):--ship.

H5601.def: from «05608»; a gem (perhaps used for scratching other substances), probably the sapphire:--sapphire.

H5602.et: from an unused root meaning to depress
H5602.def: from an unused root meaning to depress; a basin (as deepened out):--bowl, dish.

H5603.def: a primitive root; to hide by covering; specifically, to roof (passive participle as noun, a roof) or wainscot; figuratively, to reserve:--cieled, cover, seated.

H5605.def: a primitive root; properly, to snatch away, i.e. terminate; but used only as denominative from «05592» (in the sense of a vestibule), to wait at the threshold:--be a doorkeeper.

H5606.def: or saphaq (1 Kings 20:10; Job 27:23; Isaiah 2:6) {saw-fak'}; a primitive root; to clap the hands (in token of compact, derision, grief, indignation, or punishment); by implication of satisfaction, to be enough; by implication of excess, to vomit:--clap, smite, strike, suffice, wallow.

H5607.def: or sepheq (Job 20:22; 36:18) {seh'-fek}; from «05606»; chastisement; also satiety:--stroke, sufficiency.

H5608.def: a primitive root; properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate:--commune, (ac-)count; declare, number, + penknife, reckon, scribe, shew forth, speak, talk, tell (out), writer.

H5609.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «05608»; a book:--book, roll.

H5611.def: the same as «05610»; Sephar, a place in Arabia:--Sephar.

H5612.def: or (feminine) ciphrah (Psa. 56:8 («09»)) {sif-raw'}; from «05608»; properly, writing (the art or a document); by implication, a book:--bill, book, evidence, × learn(-ed) (-ing), letter, register, scroll.

H5613.def: (Aramaic) from the same as «05609»; a scribe (secular or sacred):--scribe.

H5614.def: of foreign derivation; Sepharad, a region of Assyria:--Sepharad.

H5616.def: patrial from «05617»; a Sepharvite or inhabitant of Sepharvain:--Sepharvite.

H5618.def: feminine active participle of «05608»; a scribe (properly, female); Sophereth, a temple servant:--Sophereth.

H5619.def: a primitive root; properly, to be weighty; but used only in the sense of lapidation or its contrary (as if a delapidation):--(cast, gather out, throw) stone(-s), × surely.

H5621.et: from an unused root meaning to sting
H5621.def: from an unused root meaning to sting; a thistle:--brier.

H5623.def: of foreign derivation; Sargon, an Assyrian king:--Sargon.

H5624.et: from a primitive root meaning to tremble
H5624.def: from a primitive root meaning to tremble; trembling; Sered, an Israelite:--Sered.

H5625.def: patron from «05624»; a Seredite (collectively) or descendants of Sered:--Sardites.

H5626.def: from «05493»; departure; Sirah, a cistern so-called:--Sirah. See also «05518».

H5627.def: from «05493»; apostasy, crime; figuratively, remission:--X continual, rebellion, revolt((-ed)), turn away, wrong.

H5628.def: a primitive root; to extend (even to excess):--exceeding, hand, spread, stretch self, banish.

H5631.et: from an unused root meaning to castrate
H5631.def: or caric {saw-reece'}; from an unused root meaning to castrate; a eunuch; by implication, valet (especially of the female apartments), and thus, a minister of state:--chamberlain, eunuch, officer. Compare «07249».

H5633.et: from an unused root of uncertain meaning
H5633.def: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; an axle; figuratively, a peer:--lord, plate.

H5635.def: a primitive root; to cremate, i.e. to be (near) of kin (such being privileged to kindle the pyre):--burn.

H5636.def: from «05635»; a nettle (as stinging like a burn):--brier.

H5637.def: a primitive root; to turn away, i.e. (morally) be refractory:--X away, backsliding, rebellious, revolter(-ing), slide back, stubborn, withdrew.

H5638.et: from an unused root meaning to hide
H5638.def: from an unused root meaning to hide; winter (as the dark season):--winter.

H5640.def: or satham (Numbers 24:15) {saw-tham'}; a primitive root; to stop up; by implication, to repair; figuratively, to keep secret:--closed up, hidden, secret, shut out (up), stop.

H5641.def: a primitive root; to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively:--be absent, keep close, conceal, hide (self), (keep) secret, × surely.

H5642.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05641»; to conceal; figuratively, to demolish:--destroy, secret thing.

H5643.def: or (feminine) cithrah (Deut. 32:38), {sith-raw'}; from «05641»; a cover (in a good or a bad, a literal or a figurative sense):--backbiting, covering, covert, × disguise(-th), hiding place, privily, protection, secret(-ly, place).

H5645.def: (masculine and feminine); from «05743»; properly, an envelope, i.e. darkness (or density, 2 Chron. 4:17); specifically, a (scud) cloud; also a copse:--clay, (thick) cloud, × thick, thicket. Compare «05672».

H5646.et: from an unused root meaning to cover
H5646.def: or sob {obe}; from an unused root meaning to cover; properly, equivalent to «05645»; but used only as an architectural term, an architrave (as shading the pillars):--thick (beam, plant).

H5647.def: a primitive root; to work (in any sense); by implication, to serve, till, (causatively) enslave, etc.:--X be, keep in bondage, be bondmen, bond-service, compel, do, dress, ear, execute, + husbandman, keep, labour(-ing man, bring to pass, (cause to, make to) serve(-ing, self), (be, become) servant(-s), do (use) service, till(-er), transgress (from margin), (set a) work, be wrought, worshipper,

H5648.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «05647»; to do, make, prepare, keep, etc.:--X cut, do, execute, go on, make, move, work.

H5651.def: the same as «05650»; Ebed, the name of two Israelites:--Ebed.

H5653.def: from «05647»; work; Abda, the name of two Israelites:--Abda

H5654.et: from the act part of (05647) and (0123)
H5654.def: from the active participle of «05647» and «0123»; worker of Edom; Obed-Edom, the name of five Israelites: --Obed-edom.

H5655.def: from «05647» and «0410»; serving God; Abdeel, an Israelite: Abdeel. Compare «05661».

H5656.def: or mabowdah {ab-o-daw'}; from «05647»; work of any kind:--act, bondage, + bondservant, effect, labour, ministering(-try), office, service(-ile, -itude), tillage, use, work, × wrought.

H5657.def: passive participle of «05647»; something wrought, i.e. (concretely) service:--household, store of servants.

H5658.def: from «05647»; servitude; Abdon, the name of a place in Palestine and of four Israelites:--Abdon. Compare «05683».

H5660.def: from «05647»; serviceable; Abdi, the name of two Israelites:--Abdi.

H5661.def: from «05650» and «0410»; servant of God; Abdiel, an Israelite:--Abdiel. Compare «05655».

H5662.def: or mObadyahuw {o-bad-yaw'-hoo}; active participle of «05647» and «03050»; serving Jah; Obadjah, the name of thirteen Israelites:--Obadiah.

H5663.def: from «05650» and «04428»; servant of a king; Ebed-Melek, a eunuch of Zedekeah:--Ebed-melech.

H5664.def: the same as «05665»; Abed-Nego, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel's companions:--Abed-nego.

H5665.def: (Aramaic) of foreign origin; Abed-Nego, the name of Azariah:--Abed-nego.

H5666.def: a primitive root; to be dense:--be (grow) thick(-er).

H5668.def: or rabur {aw-boor'}; passive participle of «05674»; properly, crossed, i.e. (abstractly) transit; used only adverbially, on account of, in order that:--because of, for (...'s sake), (intent) that, to.

H5669.def: the same as «05668»; passed, i.e. kept over; used only of stored grain:--old corn.

H5670.def: a primitive root; to pawn; causatively, to lend (on security); figuratively, to entangle:--borrow, break (ranks), fetch (a pledge), lend, × surely.

H5671.def: from «05670»; something pledged, i.e. (collectively) pawned goods:--thick clay (by a false etym.).

H5672.def: or mobiy {ob-ee'}; from «05666»; density, i.e. depth or width:--thick(-ness). Compare «05645».

H5673.def: (Aramaic) from «05648»; labor or business:--affairs, service, work.

H5674.def: a primitive root; to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation):--alienate, alter, × at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-)come (on, over), conduct (over), convey over, current, deliver, do away, enter, escape, fail, gender, get over, (make) go (away, beyond, by, forth, his way, in, on, over, through), have away (more), lay, meddle, overrun, make partition, (cause to, give, make to, over) pass(-age, along, away, beyond, by, -enger, on, out, over, through), (cause to, make) + proclaim(-amation), perish, provoke to anger, put away, rage, + raiser of taxes, rem

H5676.def: from «05674»; properly, a region across; but used only adverbially (with or without a preposition) on the opposite side (especially of the Jordan; ususally meaning the east):--X against, beyond, by, × from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight.

H5677.def: the same as «05676»; Eber, the name of two patriarchs and four Israelites:--Eber, Heber.

H5678.def: feminine of «05676»; an outburst of passion:--anger, rage, wrath.

H5679.def: from «05674»; a crossing-place:--ferry, plain (from the margin).

H5680.def: patronymic from «05677»; an Eberite (i.e. Hebrew) or descendant of Eber:--Hebrew(-ess, woman).

H5681.def: the same as «05680»; Ibri, an Israelite:--Ibri.

H5682.def: plural of «05676»; regions beyond; Abarim, a place in Palestine:--Abarim, passages.

H5683.def: from «05676»; transitional; Ebron, a place in Palestine:--Hebron. Perhaps a clerical error for «05658».

H5684.def: feminine of «05683»; Ebronah, place in the Desert:--Ebronah.

H5685.def: a primitive root; to dry up:--be rotten.

H5686.def: a primitive root; to interlace, i.e. (figuratively) to pervert:--wrap up.

H5687.def: or rabowth {aw-both'}; from «05686»; intwined, i.e. dense:--thick.

H5688.def: or rabowth {ab-oth'}; or (feminine) tabothah {ab- oth-aw'}; the same as «05687»; something intwined, i.e. a string, wreath or foliage:--band, cord, rope, thick bough (branch), wreathen (chain).

H5689.def: a primitive root; to breathe after, i.e. to love (sensually):--dote, lover.

H5690.def: from «05689»; love (concretely), i.e. amative words:--much love, very lovely.

H5692.def: from «05746»; an ash-cake (as round):--cake (upon the hearth).

H5693.et: pass part [but with active sense] of an unused root meaning to twitter
H5693.def: passive part (but with active sense) of an unused root meaning to twitter: probably the swallow:--swallow.

H5694.def: from the same as «05696»; something round, i.e. a ring (for the ears):--earring.

H5695.def: from the same as «05696»; a (male) calf (as frisking round), especially one nearly grown (i.e. a steer):--bullock, calf.

H5696.et: from an unused root meaning to revolve
H5696.def: or magowl {aw-gole'}; from an unused root meaning to revolve, circular:--round.

H5697.def: feminine of «05695»; a (female) calf, especially one nearly grown (i.e. a heifer):--calf, cow, heifer.

H5698.def: the same as «05697»; Eglah, a wife of David:--Eglah.

H5699.def: from the same as «05696»; something revolving, i.e. a wheeled vehicle:--cart, chariot, wagon
